title: Unit 1 Consolidation: Language as Worldview: Humboldt, Kosztolányi & Cognitive Linguistics

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can synthesize the philosophical arguments of Humboldt, Kosztolányi, and modern cognitive linguistics.
I can recall high-level terminology of linguistic relativity and digital language preservation.
I can produce structured reflections on the cultural and cognitive role of the Hungarian language.
